description: This file defines a PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Directory Service Data API, including method annotations for each API operation (both synchronous and asynchronous).

classes.name: DirectoryServiceDataClient
classes.description: A PHP class extending AwsClient used to communicate with AWS Directory Service Data. It contains method annotations for directory-related operations such as creating, deleting, describing user and group resources, and their async variants.

methods.name: addGroupMember
methods.description: Adds a member to a group in the Directory Service.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group in the Directory Service.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in the Directory Service.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes an existing group from the Directory Service.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a specified user from the Directory Service.

methods.name: describeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific group.

methods.name: describeUser
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific user.

methods.name: listGroupMembers
methods.description: Lists members of a specified group.

methods.name: listGroupsForMember
methods.description: Lists groups for a particular member.

methods.name: removeGroupMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a group.
